title: My first game has been approved on Steam!
author: StarDrifterG
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’d like to share my first game, developed with the support of AI. Steam has just approved my store page, so I’d really appreciate it if you could give the trailer a chance and check it out.

I’m also planning to release a free demo for everyone soon.

Thank you so much for your support!  
  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5131820/The\_Pilot/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5131820/The_Pilot/)

comments.author: EbbDesperate2765
comments.body: Me encanta la onda espero la demo! :D

comments.author: RDSeedTJ
comments.body: congrats. why steam not other game platforms?

replies.author: StarDrifterG
replies.body: honestly, i don't know. do you have any recommendations?

replies.author: RDSeedTJ
replies.body: I am currently transitioning my in-house gaming platform into an open web game publishing platform, set to launch in October. It will feature zero publishing fees, full-stack game hosting capabilities, and an integrated achievement bonus system for players.

comments.author: emperormarkus
comments.body:
This looks really great. I like the concept and the execution.

How was the process with Steam?

replies.author: StarDrifterG
replies.body:
Thanks! it was pretty smooth overall. I prepared the build and store materials, submitted everything for review, and then made a few small adjustments before getting it ready to publish.  
nothing too complicatedd, but there were a few details to make sure everything met Steam’s requirements.
